prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the mold from workbench and move it to tray.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether a clean mold is on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A low-angle view of a workstation. At top hangs a white sign reading "Synthesis Workstation" with Chinese characters above it, and a purple square tile bearing a black-and-white fiducial marker at its left end. Two black vertical posts support the sign area.

Upper right: a black rack holding about five clear tubes standing upright, each capped with an orange stopper; they appear empty. The rack sits on a grey extruded-aluminium frame with brackets.

Foreground: an aluminium profile platform with a white panel carrying another black-and-white marker, plus several bolts and knurled metal fittings along its right edge. Left of centre are a pale green translucent glass plate on a white pedestal and white plastic blocks. Background is a plain light wall.
observations: The description of the workbench does not mention the presence of a mold, listing only tubes on a rack, a glass plate, and plastic blocks.

args.observations: The description of the workbench does not mention the presence of a mold, listing only tubes on a rack, a glass plate, and plastic blocks.
